rationale.edition: Both changed files live under web/src/** (web/src/components/dashboards/panels/ChartRenderer.vue and web/src/views/Dashboards/RenderDashboardCharts.vue). No paths fall under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/, and no enterprise-only keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/logo-management) appear in the paths. This is a plain open-source frontend change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change is user-facing: it alters dashboard chart rendering (SVG viewBox for print scaling in ChartRenderer) and panel overflow behavior (visible to hidden in RenderDashboardCharts) during print/export. No tests-added label or skip comment was present in the empty trigger comment, and the diff adds no E2E specs.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. A dashboard's printed/exported output is a user-exercisable UI flow: with SVG-rendered charts, the new viewBox must prevent clipping, and the overflow change must not clip panels. This is a visible behavior change in web/src dashboard chart rendering, so a regression test is appropriate.
rationale.area: Area is Dashboards. Both files are dashboard-scoped: ChartRenderer renders dashboard chart panels and RenderDashboardCharts lays out the dashboard grid; sibling specs live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/.
rationale.group: playwright_group Dashboards-Charts is the closest existing matrix shard. It holds chart-rendering specs (custom-charts.spec.js, dashboard-html-chart.spec.js) in ci_matrix_cloud.json with actual_folder Dashboards, matching this chart-rendering/print change better than Dashboards-Core or Dashboards-Settings.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The changed files are application source (.vue) under web/src, not Playwright specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so there is no existing E2E coverage to extend or reconcile.
